thread:
maria: Kicking off RC creation for 2.18.0-hotpatch — tagging candidate build now. Change window UTC 02:00-04:00. Short plan: canary 1% -> 10% -> 100% over ~30m steps. Deploybot, queue candidate and run telemetry dry-run.

deploybot: [automated] queued rc-2.18.0-hotpatch-20260321-01. artifact sha: abcdef1234. canary target: eng-canary. Use `--pin=true` to hold after promote.

kyle: QA smoke on staging passed. saw one flaky e2e earlier but fixed. Recommend soft-pin until post-canary telemetry checks are green.

tina: Infra OK for KV warm. Run:```bash
redwood infra kv-warm --model=redwood-2.18 --shards=4 --ttl=10m
```Do that 10m before canary start.

dave_oncall: Oncall acknowledged. Rollback criteria we've agreed: >0.5% error rate OR p95 latency >350ms sustained for 3m -> abort + rollback to 2.18.0-stable. Also alert on token-per-request >2x baseline. I'll own the rollback if triggered. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: canary start initiated (1%) — routing to eng-canary. dashboard: https://dash.internal/releases/rc-2.18.0-hotpatch

QA-charlie: QA signoff for smoke. We ran the regression suite subset — no blocking failures. +1 but watch flaky test id: reg-314.

docs-liz: Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/2.18.0-hotpatch — included changelog and migration note about batching tweak. Please add any user-facing comments before promote.

olga: Infra: reserved dedicated pool (2 x A10) for this RC during window. Added host pin to avoid mixed-kernel scheduling.

maria: Getting all signoffs: infra (olga), QA (QA-charlie), docs (docs-liz), oncall (dave_oncall). Proceeding with canary in 10m unless objections. cc @kyle @tina

kyle: No objections. If telemetry looks good at 1%, I'll ask for lift to 10% at +30m.

tina: Reminder: batching tweak may affect avg tokens/request. Monitor cost and set quick alert.

maria: Promoting to canary 1% now. Command used: `/deploy promote --rc=rc-2.18.0-hotpatch-20260321-01 --to=canary --percent=1 --pin=soft`

deploybot: [automated] promoted to canary 1%. Starting telemetry dry-run and canary metrics collection.

monitoring-bot: canary metrics snapshot: errors 0.12% (0.12%), p95 220ms, token-per-request +4%. No alerts triggered.

dave_oncall: Acknowledged. Watching dashboards for the next 30m. Call me if errors trend up. :telephone_receiver:

maria: If all good, we plan 10% -> 100% with 30m observation windows. Soft-pin will be lifted after 10% stable. Anyone want a hard pin for this?

kyle: I'll keep soft-pin. If anything looks off at 10% I will hold.

QA-charlie: I'll run the extended smoke at 10% and report in this thread.

maria: Excellent. Thanks team — will update thread with lift or abort.

deploybot: Next step scheduled: 10% at +30m.

monitoring-bot: (30m) canary metrics: errors 0.09%, p95 230ms, token-per-request +3%. Proceeding to 10% now.

deploybot: promoted to 10%.

maria: Lifting soft-pin at 10% per kyle's go. Proceed to full rollout if 10% stable for 30m.

Last check: release notes link and internal changelog updated. If rollback happens, revert command: `/deploy rollback --to=2.18.0-stable --reason="canary regression"`.

dave_oncall: Standing by. :eyes:
